description:
## Why

Per PKIX-als9 design §7: `prune_policy_tree` (lib.rs:1145) has 3 call sites at 2298, 2504, 2819 with matching "tree becomes NULL when no nodes at depth ≥ 1" checks. Refactoring these into a single helper:
- removes ~15 lines of duplication
- makes the "tree becomes NULL" invariant explicit and named
- forms a no-risk side improvement before the higher-risk H9/H11 land that touch the same invariant

## What

Extract `pub(crate) fn policy_tree_post_op_prune(...)` that runs `prune_policy_tree` and applies the NULL-tree check. Replace the 3 call sites with calls to the helper.

## Acceptance

- New helper in pkix-path/src/lib.rs.
- 3 call sites replaced.
- All PKITS tests pass.
- clippy clean.
- No behaviour change.
title: als9: prep — extract policy_tree_post_op_prune helper (3 duplicate sites)
